'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Insurgency in Northern Chad]]
**[[2021 Northern Chad offensive|Northern Chad offensive]]
***Spokesperson for the [[Front for Change and Concord in Chad]] (FACT) Sharfadine Galmaye said that FACT was "willing to negotiate with the government to spare Chad further conflict". The rebel group is asking [[Mahamat Déby Itno]] to step down and for "an independent person who would be acceptable by all people to rule" to take his place. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2021/apr/23/chad-rebels-prepare-offensive-as-president-idriss-deby-is-buried (''The Guardian'')]
*[[War in Afghanistan (2001–present)|War in Afghanistan]]
**[[2021 Afghanistan attacks]]
***Fourteen people are killed and many others are wounded in a series of [[explosion]]s and shootings in three [[provinces of Afghanistan|provinces]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/4/24/civilians-killed-in-attacks-across-three-provinces-in-afghanistan (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]], [[Gaza–Israel conflict]]
**At least 35 [[Palestinian rocket attacks on Israel|rockets]] are fired into [[Israel]] from the [[Gaza Strip]] amidst yesterday's clashes between far-right Jewish demonstrators and Palestinians in [[Jerusalem]]. Israel retaliates by firing on targets operated by [[Hamas]] within the Strip. [https://apnews.com/article/israel-gaza-strip-middle-east-religion-jerusalem-e37ec6fe6f28f254cd617e9b4a206d3e (AP)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[KRI Nanggala (402)|KRI ''Nanggala'' (402)]]
**[[Indonesia]]n authorities discover debris from the [[submarine]] that went missing on Wednesday, as well as an [[oil spill]] off the island of [[Bali]]. In response, the [[Indonesian Navy|navy]] declares the submarine's status changed from missing to sunk, and it also declares its 53 crew members to be dead. [https://jakartaglobe.id/news/indonesian-submarine-kri-nanggala402-has-sunk-navy-confirms (''Jakarta Globe'')] [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/indonesia-submarine-sunk-killing-all-53-aboard-navy-says/ (CBS News)] [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/4/24/indonesian-searchers-recover-debris-from-missing-submarine (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on hospitals]], [[COVID-19 pandemic in Iraq]]
**[[Baghdad hospital fire]]
***A fire at a [[List of hospitals in Iraq|hospital]] in [[Baghdad]], [[Iraq]], kills 82 people and injures more than 100 others. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-56875804 (''BBC'')]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in India]]
****[[India]] reports 346,786 new cases of [[COVID-19]] in the past 24 hours, which is a world record for the third consecutive day, thereby bringing the total number of confirmed cases to 16.6 million. The country also reports a record 2,624 [[COVID-19 pandemic deaths|deaths]] in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide death toll to 189,544. [https://asia.nikkei.com/Spotlight/Coronavirus/India-s-daily-coronavirus-cases-climb-to-new-world-record (''Nikkei Asia'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Iran]]
****[[Iran]] bans all travel from [[India]] and [[Pakistan]] due to an increase in the number of COVID-19 cases in those countries as Iran's death toll surpasses 69,000. [https://abcnews.go.com/Health/wireStory/latest-pakistan-reports-highest-daily-death-toll-77284112 (ABC News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Malaysia]]
****[[Malaysia]] receives its first shipment of 268,800 doses of the [[Oxford-AstraZeneca COVID-19 vaccine|Oxford-AstraZeneca]] [[COVID-19 vaccine|vaccine]] distributed through the [[COVAX]] initiative. [https://www.malaymail.com/news/malaysia/2021/04/24/malaysia-takes-delivery-of-268800-doses-of-astrazeneca-vaccine/1969162 (''Malay Mail'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Thailand]]
****[[Thailand]] reports a record 2,839 new cases and eight deaths from COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 53,022 and the nationwide death toll to 129. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/asia/thailand-reports-2-839-new-covid-19-cases-8-more-deaths-14685280 (CNA)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Germany]]
****[[Germany]] begins to implement its "emergency brake" law designed to reduce the number of COVID-19 infections in regions with [[incidence rate]]s of more than 100 new infections per 100,000 people over the last seven days. Measures that will be taken include curfews as well as school closures in areas where the incidence rate has exceeded 165. [https://www.rfi.fr/en/germany-pulls-virus-emergency-brake-but-not-all-on-board (RFI)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Switzerland]], [[Lineage B.1.617]]
****[[Switzerland]] reports its first case of the Lineage B.1.617 variant first detected in [[India]]. [https://www.swissinfo.ch/eng/first-case-of-indian-covid-variant-detected-in-switzerland/46562448 (Swissinfo)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Oceania]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Australia]]
****[[Perth metropolitan region|Metropolitan Perth]] and [[Peel (Western Australia)|Peel]] regions enter a three-day [[COVID-19 lockdowns|lockdown]] after a person from [[Victoria (Australia)|Victoria]] tested positive in [[Melbourne]] after leaving [[quarantine]] at a [[Perth]] hotel and spending five days in the community. [https://www.abc.net.au/news/2021-04-24/perth-wakes-to-latest-covid-lockdown/100092520 (ABC Australia)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Papua New Guinea]]
****The official [[COVID-19 pandemic deaths|death toll]] from COVID-19 in [[Papua New Guinea]] surpasses 100. [https://www.usnews.com/news/world/articles/2021-04-24/pngs-official-death-toll-from-covid-19-passes-100 (U.S. News & World Report)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Costa Rica]]
***[[Costa Rica]] reports a record 1,830 new cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 238,760. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/world/costa-rica-hits-new-daily-record-of-covid-19-infections-14689530 (CNA)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Venezuela]]
***[[Venezuela]] receives another shipment of 880,000 doses of the [[Sputnik V COVID-19 vaccine|Sputnik V]] [[COVID-19 vaccine|vaccine]] as the number of cases continues to rise. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/venezuela-gets-80000-more-sputnik-v-vaccine-doses-covid-19-cases-surge-2021-04-24/ (Reuters)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Turkey–United States relations]], [[Armenian Genocide recognition]]
**In a statement commemorating [[Armenian Genocide Remembrance Day]], [[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Joe Biden]] formally acknowledges the [[Armenian Genocide|massacre of Armenians]] by the [[Ottoman Empire]] during [[World War I]] as a [[genocide]]. Turkish Foreign Minister [[Mevlüt Çavuşoğlu]] denounces Biden's statement as "political opportunism" and "based on populism". [https://www.cnn.com/2021/04/24/politics/armenian-genocide-biden-erdogan-turkey/index.html (CNN)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2019 Sri Lanka Easter bombings]]
**[[Sri Lanka]]n Member of [[Parliament of Sri Lanka|Parliament]] and former [[Ministry of Industry and Commerce (Sri Lanka)|industry minister]] [[Rishad Bathiudeen]] is arrested, along with his brother, under the [[Prevention of Terrorism Act (Sri Lanka)|Prevention of Terrorism Act]] for having connections with the perpetrators of the 2019 attack. [https://www.arabnews.com/node/1848076/world (''Arab News'')]
*[[Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on crime]], [[COVID-19 pandemic in Spain]]
**[[National Police Corps|Police]] arrest a man suspected of infecting 22 people, eight directly and 14 indirectly, with COVID-19, as part of an investigation into an outbreak in [[Manacor]], Spain. According to authorities, the suspect made no efforts to quarantine himself or wear a face mask despite showing symptoms and having taken a test. [https://www.cnn.com/2021/04/24/europe/spain-mallorca-covid-intl-scli/index.html (CNN)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2021 Louisiana's 2nd congressional district special election]]
**[[Democratic Party (United States)|Democratic]] state senator [[Troy Carter (politician)|Troy Carter]] wins the [[Two-round system|runoff election]] for a [[special election]] for [[Louisiana's 2nd congressional district]] to replace Representative [[Cedric Richmond]], who had left his position to work for President [[Joe Biden]]. [https://apnews.com/article/joe-biden-cedric-richmond-new-orleans-elections-campaigns-19b00c58d8b0360d7bac5c72199f617f (AP)]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[Human spaceflight]]
**[[SpaceX Crew-2]]
***[[SpaceX]]'s [[Crew Dragon]] [[Crew Dragon Endeavour|C206 "Endeavour"]], which is carrying four [[astronaut]]s on board, successfully docks with the [[International Space Station]]. [https://www.space.com/spacex-crew-2-dragon-space-station-docking-success (Space.com)]
